items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I would like it to be just to approach Charlotte Bronte's "Jane Eyre."

ctx.x: How about telling us a little bit about the autobiography you're working on?

Yes, I've been working on it for 20 or 25 years and I don't have a title for it yet, the autobiography, but I want to tell a story that will describe for youngsters what is before them when they say they want to come to the stage. I want to talk about a country and a world that is difficult sometimes to live in. Well, I said this before, but I would like it to be just to approach Charlotte Bronte's "Jane Eyre." With "Jane Eyre," you knew in that story, you knew who the English were, what they were socially, who…
Is there anything that you hope people will take from this autobiography?
